body_markdown:
Thrilled to share the highlights of our CEO, Dr. Rachita Navara, MD, FACC as she played a pivotal role in shaping the event’s dynamic discussions. Dr. Navara not only wrapped up HRX as a panelist, delving into innovative Home Care Models, but also co-chaired the ACC EP AI/Innovation Committee. Her expertise and leadership were instrumental in driving the conversation forward.
